comment: Chips whose iBoot leaves the CTXR windows armed on the secondaries for a kcbz-0 boot object, so the Stage 1 boot object is padded for the execute window. Read by tools/execute_window.py. Aura checks it against the CTXR probe on every boot and warns when they disagree. See docs/macho-boot-object.md#which-chips-pad-the-boot-object.
